# Structured Self-Study, a Roadmap for Game Development Using C# and Unity

#### This roadmap was initially generated by GPT-6.1 Sol. I have no idea how good of a job this will do, but I like structured learning. I'll make changes as I go if I feel the need. My current level of programming skill is advanced beginner/early intermediate; decent fundamentals with varied and spotty knowledge past that.
<details><summary>FAQ/Personal Notes</summary>

### My Stance on AI
#### I use AI at work as we aren't a company that makes software for customers. We use it to make internal tools that make our jobs easier. It produces results which is what is important. As for personal projects, AI is solely used as a glorified search engine and/or mentoring for programming. Any personal projects will not have any AI generated code.

### Why Unity?
#### Just my preference. I don't necessarily have a reason. Although, one of my favorite games is Last Epoch which is made in Unity. It'd be pretty sweet to snag a job as a LE dev. Pipe dream? Maybe. But Michael Scott once said, "'You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.' -Wayne Gretzky". Also, Shia said to just do it.
</details>
